title: Trillanes says he backed out as impeachment witness to relieve ‘pressure’ on prosecution
summary: Former senator Antonio Trillanes IV said Thursday he backed out from appearing as a witness in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte to relieve the “pressure” on the prosecution panel.
